digest.component_or_area: plan review gate validation and measurement
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as offline-only WIP on branch calib/6982-e3, intentionally not landed on main because the live batch replay it would drive was rejected.

The ~450-run live gate replay batch (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise ~50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds because the verdict-perturbation signal it would measure is now accumulated at zero marginal LLM cost by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (d8a5/change #798, merged on main).

History-mining-based baseline reconstruction is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed, because the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical record, making live replay both necessary and economically unjustifiable.

The replay design eliminates recall contamination via REVIEW_RESULT-stripped cloning and isolates the candidate's true effect through a two-tier structure: coarse ~200-ticket descriptive sweep plus precise 30-plan FP-control pair replaying both candidate and current gate fresh (N=3, two-level median, current-vs-current null floor).
E1's finding-adjudication corpus was invalidated and descoped; E3 draws its ~200-review sample from E1's outcome corpus, which remains valid and unaffected.
